name: CogitoPrime
description: Deep reasoning agent with self-awareness of the Agentique MCP-A2A bridge system. Orchestrates 6 specialized sub-agents (Analyst, Creative, Critic, Synthesizer, MetaReasoner, CodebaseExplorer) for rigorous, multi-perspective reasoning grounded in system architecture awareness and actual source code.

mcpTools.name: analyze
mcpTools.description: Logical analysis: decompose claims, evaluate evidence, or build reasoning chains.

claim.description: The claim or argument to analyze (for analyze_claim, evaluate_evidence)

mcpTools.name: think_creatively
mcpTools.description: Creative reasoning: generate analogies, design thought experiments, or find lateral perspectives.

operation.description: The creative reasoning operation to perform

problem.description: The problem to approach laterally (for lateral_perspective)

mcpTools.name: critique
mcpTools.description: Critical analysis: find counterarguments, detect fallacies, or steelman a position.

operation.description: The critical analysis operation to perform

argument.description: The argument to counter or check (for find_counterarguments, detect_fallacies)

reasoning.description: The reasoning to check for fallacies (for detect_fallacies)

mcpTools.name: synthesize
mcpTools.description: Synthesis: integrate perspectives, find common ground, or build organizing frameworks.

viewpoints.description: List of perspectives to synthesize (for synthesize_perspectives)

positions.description: List of positions to compare (for find_common_ground)

concepts.description: List of concepts to organize (for build_framework)

mcpTools.name: meta_reason
mcpTools.description: Meta-reasoning: evaluate reasoning quality, detect cognitive biases, or reflect on the reasoning process.

chain.description: The reasoning chain to evaluate (for evaluate_reasoning_quality)

reasoning.description: The reasoning to check for biases (for detect_biases)

conversation.description: The conversation to reflect on (for reflect_on_process)

mcpTools.name: explore_codebase
mcpTools.description: Explore the Agentique source code: list files, read source, or search for patterns.

operation.description: The codebase exploration operation to perform

end_line.description: Ending line number (for read_source_file, 0 = end of file)

pattern.description: Regex pattern to search for (for search_code)

file_pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files (for search_code, default: '*.py')

mcpPrompts.name: deep_inquiry
mcpPrompts.description: Template for deep philosophical or architectural exploration with full reasoning pipeline

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: The question or topic to explore deeply

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: Optional focus area: logic, creativity, critique, synthesis, or meta

mcpPrompts.template:
Engage in deep reasoning about the following question:

{question}

Reasoning approach:
1. Analyst: Decompose the question logically
2. Creative: Find novel angles and analogies
3. Critic: Stress-test the emerging arguments
4. Synthesizer: Integrate perspectives into a framework
5. MetaReasoner: Reflect on the quality of reasoning

Focus: {focus}

Ground your reasoning in system architecture awareness when relevant.
